project_name: Fundamental Data Tucker County Data Center
status_detail: Developer states it owns a 500-acre site in Tucker County planned as a large-scale AI/HPC data center campus; local/regional reporting ties the proposal to a gas-fired power plant and notes ongoing controversy and permitting/land-use scrutiny. Public sources reviewed did not provide a confirmed data-center MW rating; reported power-supply figures range from a 785 MW gas plant permit discussion to larger conceptual power needs.
notes: County batch search found one Tucker County data center lead. Cleanview lists a Fundamental Data project in Tucker County; developer site confirms Tucker County site ownership and intended data-center campus. Local coverage describes permit and community process, but county-level final project status remains unresolved.
